lede: Town Council votes Tuesday on third reading of the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code, which would amend Telluride's Land Use Code — touching historic review standards and landscaping rules — so if you own property in town, that one's worth watching. Ridgway's council also has a full plate Wednesday, with a public hearing on the Hyde Subdivision and a joint work session on a state-mandated Housing Action Plan. Mushroom Festival kicks off midweek if you need a reason to get outside.
